title: Reschedule Move Distance on Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts
content:
How far a Ridgeline Installation Services customer moves the installation sets the move-distance share of the customer reschedule fee.

## Move-distance share

The move distance is the number of calendar days from the original installation date to the new installation date the reschedule request asked for. The request is the most recent customer reschedule request on the contract that was carried out (request status completed); the new date is the date that request asked for.

| Move distance | Move-distance share |
|---|---|
| at most the same-week days of 7 | 0.8, the same-week share |
| more than the long-move floor of 28 days | 1.25, the long-move multiple |
| any other move distance (8 to 28 days) | 1 |

The customer reschedule fee is multiplied by the move-distance share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the customer reschedule fee is rounded, the customer reschedule fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical original installation date 10 March)

| New date asked for | Move distance | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 17 March | 7 days | 0.8 |
| 18 March | 8 days | 1 |
| 7 April | 28 days | 1 |
| 8 April | 29 days | 1.25 |

## Points of judgement

- The move distance runs from the original installation date, the first date booked on the contract, not from the date booked just before this reschedule.
- The new date is the date asked for on the reschedule request itself.

**Hypothetical:** with a fee of 150.00 before the share, a move of 29 days gives 187.50 and a move of 5 days gives 120.00.
